svg.metadata: {"title": "Filament spool", "description": "Bambu style: brand, type, colour, product code, temperatures, dates, and a code built from them (and a Data Matrix of it). Rows count the serial up.", "fields": {"brand": {"default": "Bambu Lab"}, "type": {"default": "PLA Basic"}, "color": {"default": "Jade White"}, "sku": {"default": "", "help": "product code, e.g. 10100"}, "temps": {"default": "190–230 °C"}, "bought": {"default": "{{date}}"}, "opened": {"default": "", "help": "empty: a line to write on"}, "serial": {"default": "", "help": "empty: the row number"}, "code": {"help": "empty: brand-type-yymmdd-serial"}}, "computed": {"sn": "{{#serial}}{{serial}}{{/serial}}{{^serial}}{{n}}{{/serial}}", "code": "{{brand|brand}}-{{type|type}}-{{bought|yymmdd}}-{{sn|pad:2}}"}, "example": {"brand": "Bambu Lab", "type": "PETG HF", "color": "Black", "sku": "33102", "temps": "230–260 °C"}}
